correctness.rationale: Rotational invariance gives S=||U_p||^2~Beta(p/2,q/2) and beta-prime Y=(1-S)/S. Splitting radial function min of two factor radii yields convergent I0,I1 and exact M_t(r)=r^{-qt/n}(I0+r^t I1)/B. Moving-boundary terms cancel on log-r differentiation, leaving sign pJ+-qJ-. The log derivative of J+/J- is -(n-t)/2 times the strictly positive difference of E[X/(1+r^2 X)] across separated x>1 and x<1 supports, hence strictly monotone sign(t-n). Verified endpoint ratios straddle q/p in opposite orientations for t<n and t>n, proving one global max/min respectively. At t=n volume makes M constant; symmetry p=q yields r*=1; t=n+2 uses inertia integral and gives r^2=(q+2)/(p+2).
residual_risks: Only determinant-one orthogonal two-factor ball products and positive real t, p,q positive integers. No optimizer claim among unrestricted linear images, shears, translations, or higher-dimensional sections. Known isotropic position extremality at t=n+2 is not novelty.
